rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care
rules.quote: Patients who are at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.

rules.label: Denver Health Sliding Fee Discount Program
rules.quote: If you live outside of Denver County, you can always receive emergency medical care at Denver Health, even if you qualify for Medicaid or CHP+. You MUST live in Denver County to receive non-emergent care at Denver Health under the DHSFDP.

notes: Policy mentions that enrollment in discount programs (DHSFDP and HDC) requires annual screening by an enrollment specialist.
Policy includes instructions for updating contact information for Health First Colorado (Medicaid) and CHP+ members.
Policy provides multiple methods for applying for Medicaid, CHP+, DHSFDP, or HDC including online, phone, and in-person locations.
Policy states that falsifying information on family size, income, housing status, or home location is considered fraud and must be reported to the state of Colorado.
Policy describes various health insurance enrollment resources and FAQs unrelated to discounted care eligibility.
hdc may leave out a condition: Policy requires screening/application for HDC, not automatic eligibility based solely on FPL.
dhsfdp may leave out a condition: Policy requires residency for DHSFDP but also specifies non-emergent care only; emergency care is allowed regardless of residency.
